rows.corpus_definition: The official who makes sure players follow rules during games.
rows.example_en: The referee blew his whistle to stop play.

rows.corpus_definition: A note or document that provides information about something.
rows.example_en: I used the book as a reference.

rows.corpus_definition: To feel sad or sorry about something you did.
rows.example_en: I regret not studying harder for the exam.

rows.corpus_definition: To show how two things are connected or linked together.
rows.example_en: These two problems relate to each other.

rows.corpus_definition: To show or find a link between two things.
rows.example_en: Can you relate this problem to the recent changes?

rows.corpus_definition: The part of something that is left over after the rest is gone.
rows.example_en: We spent the remainder of the day reading books.

rows.corpus_definition: to produce young; to make a copy of something
rows.example_en: Some animals reproduce only once a year.

rows.corpus_definition: A cold-blooded animal that has skin covered in scales.
rows.example_en: A snake is a common type of reptile.

rows.corpus_definition: to need something for a specific purpose
rows.example_en: This job will require a lot of patience.

rows.corpus_definition: a person who lives in a specific house or place.
rows.example_en: Every resident must follow these building rules.

rows.corpus_definition: To officially leave a job or position.
rows.example_en: She decided to resign from her post yesterday.
